about.title: About EaDo Family Dental
text: After majoring in Biology at Syracuse University, Dr. Williams graduated in the top 10% in her class at NYU dental school making her a distinguished inductee to the OKU National Dental Honors Society.

As a former New Yorker of Queens and Long Island, working private practice in Houston has been a personally fulfilling journey for Dr. Williams. Alongside her husband, Dr. Ma, she hopes to encourage happier, healthier smiles in the Houston community.
When he was only 4 years old Dr. John Ma smiled a big toothy grin at his first dental appointment and proudly exclaimed that he wanted to be a dentist one day, too!
